name: Rich In Heaven
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize eternal treasures over earthly wealth, warning that earthly riches are vulnerable to decay and theft (Matthew 6:19; Luke 12:33). True life and fulfillment are not found in material abundance but in seeking God's kingdom and righteousness first (Matthew 6:33; Luke 12:15). Jesus teaches that generosity, especially toward the poor, stores up imperishable treasure in heaven and reflects a heart aligned with His call to discipleship (Matthew 19:21; Luke 14:13). Believers are thus encouraged to invest in heavenly riches through faith, obedience, and compassionate giving.
